This [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' was the great-uncle of [[Mils Giel]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Beheboth" />

Giel's great-uncle was a retired [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], having served from the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When Giel fell out of favor with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], he hid on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]] with his aide, [[Malka]]. Giels kept a low profile and survived the harsh planet by receiving [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from his great-uncle.<ref name="Beheboth" />
